question: A shopkeeper buys 20 pens for a total of ₹200. He sells each pen for ₹12. What is his total profit?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CP of 1 pen = 200 ÷ 20 = ₹10

SP of 1 pen = ₹12

Profit on 1 pen = 12 − 10 = ₹2

Total profit on 20 pens = 20 × 2 = ₹40

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total CP of 20 pens = ₹200

SP of each pen = ₹12

Total number of pens = 20

**Formula Used:**

Total SP = SP of 1 unit × Total number of units

Profit = Total SP &min
